messages:
noa (ML Eng): Quick note — onboarding cetus-40k int3-compact shows a reproducible drift exactly at token 8192 during long prefill. FP16 fine.
yuri (research): 8192? classic power-of-two wrap. Did you capture KV write/read pointers?
noa (ML Eng): Yup. In int3 runs write pointer resets (8192 -> 0) while read stays at 8192. Attached minimal repro (small script).
tess (infra): Likely packed-buffer modulo or memcpy remainder bug in the int3 packer. We changed the pack stride recently.
yuri (research): If write wraps early the RoPE phase index will be wrong leading to phase-shifted attention and semantic drift.
noa (ML Eng): Eval diffs: FP16 vs INT3 on long-QA: EM drop 14pts after 9k tokens.
opsbot: Scheduled nightly staging run for cetus-40k int3/int4/fp16 and will post diffs here.
tess (infra): Immediate mitigation: route prefill_len >= 8000 to int4 variant on staging and add a runtime flag to dump full KV on detection.
yuri (research): I'll try a tiny C harness to reproduce packed memcpy wrap. If it's arithmetic we can patch pack stride.
noa (ML Eng): Filed INFR-9430 with logs and artifact tarball. Assign: yuri for repro, tess for runtime trace, noa to coordinate routing. Will update when I have failing unit test. :thumbsup:
